# opencode-scheduled-messages

> Schedule a message into an existing OpenCode V2 session. Write at peak, send off-peak. Single-user, self-hosted, zero-dependency Node gateway with a SQLite queue and a mobile PWA.

Canonical page: https://eavebounty.github.io/opencode-scheduled-messages/
Repository: https://github.com/EaveBounty/opencode-scheduled-messages
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-scheduled-messages
Version: 0.1.0 (2026-10-26)
License: PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0

## What it is

- A scheduler that appends a prompt to a specific existing OpenCode V2 session
  via `POST /api/session/{id}/prompt`, or creates a new session on request.
- A single Node.js process (Node >= 22.6.0) with zero runtime dependencies,
  SQLite persistence (`node:sqlite`), SSE and a mobile-first PWA.
- A deep-link bridge to OpenCode's native web UI for full transcript fidelity.

## What it is not

- Not an OpenCode plugin. V2 plugins cannot register HTTP routes or own a durable timer.
- Not a fork of OpenCode; it injects no scripts into the native web UI.
- Not multi-user: one gateway, one OpenCode instance, one access token.
- Not a recurring cron system in 0.1; schedules are one-shot.

## Measured facts

- npm tarball: 148 KB packed, 325 KB unpacked, 28 files (`npm pack`, 2026-10-26).
- Tests: 39 passing via `npm test`, no network and no LLM calls.
- Idle memory: 70-110 MB RSS, peak near 150 MB (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
- Scheduler tick: 10 seconds; grace window: 120 minutes; busy wait: 30 minutes.
- DeepSeek peak: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday-Friday.
  Off-peak token price is half the peak price (peak is 2x off-peak).
- Official DeepSeek pricing: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing

## Install

    npx opencode-scheduled-messages

Requires Node.js >= 22.6.0 and a running OpenCode V2 server. The first start
prints a one-time access token; the PWA is served on http://127.0.0.1:8788.
For a phone: `ocsched --lan`, or Tailscale / Cloudflare Tunnel for HTTPS.
